title: Section B set (our own questions) and mark scheme
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 47 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Section B set (our own questions) and mark scheme)
intro: Lesson 47: Section B exam questions: 2.1 to 2.9. To understand how to answer Section B belief questions accurately with set passages

questions.q: Explain what 92:5-10 teaches about free will. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: People choose to give and fear Allah or to be stingy; Allah eases the path each chooses, so people are responsible.
questions.model: Point 1: humans make real choices. Develop: 'as for he who gives and fears Allah ... We will ease him toward ease' (92:5-7). Point 2: choices have consequences. Develop: 'as for he who withholds ... We will ease him toward difficulty' (92:8-10).

questions.q: The five categories of action are part of ...

Section B set on the pupil PDF (our own questions): five 4-mark questions across 2.1 to 2.9 and one 12-mark: 'If everything is decreed, people cannot be held responsible for their actions.' Assess. Timed: 27 minutes.
questions.a: Mark-scheme style answers; 12-mark uses the predestination hadith and 92:5-10 with a justified judgement
questions.model: Teacher answers the first 4-mark question aloud.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which belief most affects daily life?
